title: DependencyInvalidation
description: What a human edit of the chosen action invalidated, recomputed and preserved (HAR-97 E11 edit propagation; HAR-145 'Human edit / recomputation visualization'). Derived at read time from stored facts only: the saved edits or the HumanDelta's literal changes, the candidate's EvalBundle (the evals on the OLD artifact), the send-time re-evaluation batch of the FINAL artifact, and the account state version before and after. Nothing is predicted and nothing is fabricated: an object is `invalidated` only because a declared dependency says the edited field feeds it (an eval is declared independent of a field explicitly, an eval the table does not know depends on every field); `recomputed` lists only rows that exist; an invalidated object nothing re-derived is listed in `not_recomputed` (semantic evals are not re-run at send time, the set is not re-ranked, knowledge use is not re-judged). A send whose re-run of an eval that was declared independent of every edit nevertheless changed its verdict is reported as invalidated (undeclared dependency), never preserved.

status.description: not_decided: no candidate chosen yet. unedited: chosen (or sent) with no edit, so nothing is invalidated. edits_pending: edits are saved and the send has not happened, so the invalidation is known and nothing has been recomputed yet. reevaluated: sent with edits; the final artifact was re-evaluated at send time by the deterministic evals (the status does not claim more: semantic evals are not re-run, the set is not re-ranked and knowledge use is not re-judged, so those stay in not_recomputed). discarded: the decision was discarded, the edited artifact was never used. recomputation_unavailable: sent with edits, but the send-time batch is not linked (sent before the link was recorded); invalidation is listed, recomputed is empty.

semantic_labels.description: The HumanDelta's worker-assigned labels (delta-level: the worker labels the whole change). Empty before the send or when the delta is unlabeled.

account_state.description: A human edit never writes account state, but preserved is PROVEN, not assumed. version_before is the version the run read; version_after is the version the send-time evaluation stored that it read (null before the send). preserved compares the stored version and the stored sha-256 of the state document: true when both match, false when either differs, null (unknown) when either side cannot be established (before the send, a run with no pinned version, a state that cannot be read). An unknown or false state is never listed as preserved.

allOf.description: No version read by a send, nothing to compare: unknown.

entries.description: One entry per edit, in edit order. Empty when nothing was edited.

preserved_overall.description: Objects no edit touched (the intersection of every entry's preserved set). With no edit it is everything: the account state and every eval of the candidate.

field.description: The part of the action an edit changes.

semanticClass.description: A coarse deterministic class of the edit (the literal kind decides it). The worker's finer labels are the delta's semantic_labels.

kind.description: The literal change kind of human_delta.literal_changes.

before.description: The draft's value, null when the edit adds something.

after.description: The human's value, null when the edit removes something.

kind.description: artifact_field: a part of the candidate's action (ref_id is the candidate). ranking_rationale: why the candidate ranked where it did (ref_id is the candidate). knowledge_use_claim: the claim that the draft applies a piece of company knowledge (ref_id is the knowledge). eval_result: one EvalResult (ref_id is its id). final_artifact: the artifact as sent (ref_id is the human strategy decision). account_state: the account's state (ref_id is the account).

field.description: The edited field the object depends on, where it has one.

verdict.description: For an eval_result, its verdict (null when the eval was not relevant or the ref is not an eval).

replaces.description: For a re-evaluated eval_result, the id of the old result it replaces.

invalidated.description: What this edit made stale, each with its reason.

recomputed.description: The new rows that re-derive invalidated objects; each names what it replaces.

not_recomputed.description: Invalidated objects that nothing re-derived, with the reason; the honest gap.

preserved.description: Objects this edit does not touch.

allOf.description: No edit, nothing invalidated. A discarded decision invalidated nothing either: the edited artifact was never used.
Before the send nothing has been recomputed.
